narrative.intro: Nelnet Servicing works with the federal government under a compact set of contracts. Nelnet Servicing has $294M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date, spread across 8 awards with an average award size of $36.8M. Nelnet Servicing obligations are down 25.9% year over year in the current fiscal-year comparison. Nelnet Servicing recorded obligations of $145M in FY21, $240M in FY22, $351M in FY23, $407M in FY24, and $397M in FY25 before the current-year total. Nelnet Servicing carries partial-year totals for FY2026, so the $294M figure covers fiscal year to date activity rather than a full fiscal year. Nelnet Servicing award counts and average award size indicate a concentrated portfolio rather than a large number of small contracts. Nelnet Servicing obligations by year show a rise from FY21 through FY24, a small decline in FY25, and a further decline in FY26 to date. Nelnet Servicing data here are focused on contract obligations, while some tables in the record use award-value totals for individual contracts.
